_comment: Provenance manifest for the Camp Kanawana visual archive. Every identified pre-2016 image gets an entry here BEFORE the image file lands, so provenance and rights are recorded. When an image is added to this directory, set status='acquired' and fill 'filename'. Canadian copyright note: photographs created before 1949 are generally public domain in Canada (and most pre-1972 published works), so the early archival images below are safely displayable.
